extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath Agents/Studio Web modal titled "Select agent type" for creating a new agent. The Autonomous agent type card is selected, while Conversational (Preview) and Coded are available options. The Autopilot prompt text area is focused under "What should your agent do?", and the Generate Agent button is disabled until text is entered.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Autonomous card if it is not already selected. In the "What should your agent do?" text area, enter a description of the agent you want to create. Click on "Generate Agent" once the button becomes enabled, or click "Start fresh" to create the agent manually without Autopilot.
